message: 忠告と警告

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. Don't you think it'd be fine to take a break just for this week~?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's that, and this is this.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why we're doing it in shifts, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「For tomorrow's sake, and for everyone studying hard right now, I'll give it my all today!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. It is better to have a clear switch between work and rest to focus, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Exactly.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then let's work extra hard today to cover for everyone else♪」
Well, just being alone with Ria-senpai makes patrolling worth it for me.
Ria-senpai's eyes are wide open.

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... did I just say what I was thinking out loud!?」

name: Ria
message: 「No, that's not it.」
Her gaze was directed past my back.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「You two again?」
A cold voice that sent a chill down my spine.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「This is the second time I've warned you. Go home immediately.」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Even if you say that...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It's exam period right now. You should leave security to the guards.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sensei! This is something only the Student Council can do... So...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「What will you do if doing nothing but this affects your grades? You're a scholarship student, aren't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sensei!」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「You're a third-year, aren't you? Normally, an upperclassman ought to be the one reprimanding a junior, not joining in with them.」

name: Ria
message: 「This was ordered directly by Chairwoman Helena Kujou. So--」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Therefore, a student teacher has no authority to reprimand me for that」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Did you think you could threaten me with that?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I didn't mean it like that...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「The chairwoman's little sister throwing her weight around and doing whatever she pleases. The way you put it, no one could blame me for seeing it that way」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood. We'll head home in just a little while」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I see... Be careful on the dark roads at night」

name: Synn
message: 「It's dangerous for you to be making detours too, Sensei」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「...Hmph」
At this point, my suspicion turns into certainty. For once, here's a teacher I really can't stand.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, I'm sorry. It's my fault...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, it's my fault for carelessly bringing up my big sister's name. When she fires back like that, my hands are completely tied, ahaha\s02」
Even as she forces a wry smile, she's biting her lip. It must have really frustrated her.

name: Synn
message: 「That teacher... What do you suppose she's doing in a place like this?」

name: Ria
message: 「Patrolling... maybe?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if it's for work... I doubt Helena-san would ever approve of this」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. She's probably doing it on her own. You could take that as her just being extra motivated, though--」

name: Synn
message: 「If she has some other motive--」

name: Ria
message: 「That's a whole different story, isn't it」
I don't think being suspicious of each other is healthy, but we're not playing games here either.

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry for being such an unreliable senpai」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「I couldn't... protect you, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, don't say that! Someone like me is always getting saved by you, Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll do better next time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Next time, I'm gonna snap right back at 'em, loud and clear~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai……?」

name: Ria
message: 「Bleh~~!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aha…… ahaha!」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Huh? Why are you laughing~~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Senpai…… your mood just swings all over the place so fast」

name: Ria
message: 「R-Really?」

name: Synn
message: 「So, I couldn't help it……」

name: Ria
message: 「G-Geez! You're not supposed to make fun of your senpai, okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「Next time, I'll be right there with you」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll stand up to them right alongside you, Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Y…… Yeah……」

name: Synn
message: 「This time, I'll be the one protecting you, Senpai」

name: Synn
message: 「Or is saying that trying a little too hard to sound cool?」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey~~! Don't tease your senpai like that~~!!」

name: Ria
message: 「G-Geez…… Synn-kun, you really make my heart skip a beat every no~w and then……!」
